summary.default: Dedicated Clinical Research professional with 5+ years of comprehensive experience across Phase II–IV trials, specializing in site management, regulatory compliance, and data integrity. Proven track record facilitating monitoring visits, resolving complex data queries, and maintaining audit-ready Trial Master Files. Dual-background in clinical operations and AI-powered software engineering.

variants.cra_focused: Clinical Research professional with 5+ years of site-level and CRO-adjacent experience in Phase II–IV trials, transitioning into a CRA role with hands-on expertise in SIV, IMV, and COV preparation, SDV, ICH-GCP compliance, and TMF/eTMF management across multi-center studies.
variants.coordinator_focused: Experienced Clinical Research Coordinator with 5+ years managing complex Phase II–IV trial portfolios. Proven ability to reduce query resolution time, accelerate enrollment, and maintain 100% protocol adherence across multiple concurrent studies in high-volume research environments.
variants.operations_focused: Clinical Operations professional with 5+ years of cross-functional experience spanning study start-up, regulatory file management, EDC data entry, and monitoring visit facilitation. Strong process improvement track record with measurable impact on enrollment, data quality, and site compliance.
variants.tech_hybrid_focused: Clinical Research professional and software engineer uniquely positioned to bridge clinical operations and digital health. Deep expertise in ICH-GCP, EDC systems, and regulatory compliance combined with hands-on experience building AI-powered tools and data pipelines.

bullets.text: Managed a high-priority portfolio of 8+ Phase II–IV trials while ensuring 100% adherence to complex protocols.
Reduced query resolution time by 30% through the implementation of proactive weekly internal data reviews.
Facilitated 15+ Monitoring Visits (IMVs) with zero critical findings by maintaining audit-ready site files.
Accelerated participant enrollment by 20% by optimizing pre-screening workflows in collaboration with the principal investigator.
Achieved a 95% subject retention rate across long-term studies via personalized subject engagement strategies.
Orchestrated the successful close-out of two Phase II studies by resolving all action items ahead of contractual deadlines.
Oversaw execution of 12 clinical protocols while consistently exceeding sponsor-defined enrollment targets.
Decreased protocol deviations by 15% through the development of site-specific source document templates.
Completed 100% of data entry into EDC systems (Medidata Rave) within the mandated 24-hour window.
Led site through successful mock audits by identifying and correcting key documentation gaps in the TMF.
Maintained 100% compliance with IATA shipping regulations for high-volume laboratory specimen processing.
Collaborated with CRAs to resolve 200+ historical data queries, significantly improving site quality metrics.
Streamlined study start-up timelines by 14 days through aggressive tracking of essential regulatory packets.
Audited 500+ regulatory files for accuracy and completeness prior to submission to the Sponsor and CRO.
Supported the launch of 5 multi-center trials by coordinating Site Initiation Visits and investigator training.
Maintained the eTMF with a 98% accuracy rate by identifying missing documents before site monitoring visits.
Tracked investigational product for 10 active sites to ensure zero instances of temperature excursions.
